title: The Incidence of Gall Stones After Bariatric Surgery and Its Association With Weight Loss
brief_summary: The incidence of Gall Stones after Bariatric surgery and its association with weight loss
raw_criteria:
Inclusion Criteria:

* (BMI) ≥35kg/m2 with one or more obesity-related comorbidities
* a BMI \> 40 kg/m2 without coexisting medical problems

Exclusion Criteria:

-a conrtaindication for bariatric surgery
study_population: Methods This was a prospective study conducted in Helwan University Hospitals in Egypt including 148 consecutive patients underwent BS during the period between December 2018 and December 2019. Patients with preoperative negative abdominal ultrasound(US) for GS were followed-up for at least 12 months.
